name: Barton
description: A stitcher who does not care whether parts match.

description_citations.work: Innistrad: Crimson Vow: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Innistrad: Crimson Vow: card flavor text (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barton comments that his stitched creations usually work.
timeline.quote: Works every time! Well, every time they don't explode, anyway.

citation.text: Flip the Switch (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barton states he does not want matching parts.
timeline.quote: If I wanted all the parts to match, I wouldn't have become a stitcher.

citation.text: Skywarp Skaab (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A stitcher who comments on switches that sometimes explode.
